messages:
maria: heads up — we've seen some SRE tickets about webhook consumers dropping audit events when retries exceed 5. How should the console surface that to tenants? Need UX + telemetry for compliance teams.
chris: we should show a 'delivery status' column in the Audit Exports table. statuses: pending, delivering, failed, dead-letter. include link to retry history.
jamal: agree. also need per-tenant webhook throttles + quota usage in same view. ops want to know if it's a quota block vs consumer 5xx.
maria: good point. want to capture failure reason: 4xx vs 5xx vs network timeout vs TLS. That should be searchable/filterable.
chris: can we log per-attempt metadata in the audit stream? small footprint: attempt_ts, status_code, latency_ms, attempt_id. NDJSON sample:
```json
{"event_id":"evt-123","attempt_id":"a-1","ts":"2026-02-01T12:00:00Z","status_code":502,"latency_ms":120}
```
jamal: +1. this will help customers reconcile misses. but watch volume — maybe sample on success, full for failures.
elaine: on UI side, show latest attempt + count of retries and a collapsed timeline. clicking expands attempt details and stacktrace if present.
maria: what about export consumers? Some want at-least-once semantics, others want at-most-once. we need contract/versioning in API and a 'delivery_guarantee' field.
chris: propose delivery_guarantee: [at_least_once, at_most_once], and a header X-Redwood-Audit-Attempt: attempt_id for idempotency. example header snippet: `X-Redwood-Audit-Attempt: a-1`
jamal: telemetry: emit meter for 'webhook.delivery.failure' with tags: tenant, reason, delivery_guarantee. that will let us power alerting and quota policy tuning.
maria: sounds good. @devops-bot can you add a follow-up task for the Console team to mock the table and the API changes?
devops-bot: created task INFR-789 on jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFR-789 :white_check_mark:
elaine: will prototype a table mock tomorrow. cc @chris for API sketch.
chris: i'll draft a simple API diff and post it here later today. :thumbsup:
